attributes.action: Ban public fireworks sales and introduce a licence for buyers
attributes.additional_details: This petition calls on the Government to end the sale of fireworks to the general public. Fireworks are explosives, yet anyone over 18 can buy them with no training or checks. Only people who apply for a licence and give a valid reason, such as a professional display, could buy them. This would protect pets, wildlife and vulnerable people, cut injuries and fires, and ease pressure on emergency services, while keeping safe, organised displays.
attributes.background: Fireworks are explosives, yet anyone over 18 can buy them. They terrify animals, distress veterans, vulnerable people, injure bystanders and drain emergency services. We urge the Government to end public sales, allowing purchase only by licensed buyers keeping safe, organised displays.

rejection.details:
We have just opened a petition on the subject of banning private sale and use of fireworks, so they can be used only at licensed displays. You may wish to sign this.

Ban the sale and use of fireworks to the general public
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785893
